name: ximing-grok-plugins
description: ximing's Grok plugins. Skills are vendored from their source repos; this catalog is generated, not hand-edited.

plugins.name: rab
plugins.description: RAB skills for coding agents: rab-react (@rabjs/react conventions), rab-cdp-debug (CDP debugging of live rab apps), rab-rn-debug (React Native debug bridge)

plugins.name: csi
plugins.description: CSI skills for coding agents: csi (drive the user's real Chrome browser — navigate, click, type, screenshot, save PDF — via the local daemon), csi-e2e (turn natural-language browser scenarios into replayable e2e regression suites)

plugins.name: inwit
plugins.description: Inwit skill for coding agents: throw notes, questions, and clips into the user's Inwit instance over HTTP (PAT). The app still digests, reviews, and maintains the knowledge map.

plugins.name: vital
plugins.description: Operate the user's Vital personal OS (inbox, tasks, threads, habits, days, reports) through its HTTP API with a personal access token.

plugins.name: moment
plugins.description: Moment skill for coding agents: record chains, moments, feed, media, share links, and monthly recaps over HTTP with a personal access token.
